punchline: Godin noticed that the cows along a French road faded from view within minutes, and that a purple one would not.
thirty_sec: Seth Godin describes driving through the French countryside: the cows were interesting at first, then invisible. Marketing has the same problem. A purple cow would be worth mentioning. That is Godin's point: make something remarkable, because spending to advertise an ordinary product just gets it lost in the field.
